lines: If you sell land on installments in Nigeria, you know this.
Most Nigerians buy land in installments, paying over months or years.
But the companies selling it still track everything by hand.
Receipts on WhatsApp.
Schedules in Excel.
Commission arguments every month end.
So we built Terratrail.
Create a subscription, and every installment is scheduled for you.
Automatically.
Receipts come in.
You approve them in one tap.
The balance updates itself.
Your reps see exactly what they've earned.
No more disputes.
And buyers get a beautiful page to explore estates and book inspections.
Terratrail is live today.
Landrite by GOE is our first paying customer.
Lumina Properties is running a pilot.
And Rehoboth Properties has committed to pay once we ship the integration they asked for.
Over 5,000 companies have registered with REDAN, Nigeria's association of real estate developers.
And most of them still run their sales on spreadsheets and WhatsApp.
We're not new to this.
We've worked on both sides of the problem, as operations executives inside real estate companies and as real estate investors ourselves.
We've built products and a startup before.
I'm the hustler.
Demilade is the hacker.
Sammy is the hipster.
Together, we are Terratrail.
With this grant, we'll do three things.
First, ship the integrations our customers are already asking for.
Second, build an AI layer that gives business owners intelligence just by chatting with their data.
And third, bring Terratrail to 30 real estate companies, helping them recover payments and saving them hours.
No spreadsheet. No WhatsApp. No wahala.
